svg.aria-label: A 3D SKU by SKU switching matrix: extruded cells whose height shows how often shoppers move between products.
svg.title: SKU x SKU switching structure

g.text: every bar is one SKU pair; taller means more switching. reading this fast is what
pricing and assortment decisions rest on.
built as an interactive Streamlit explorer at Aria; cut the analysis from days to minutes.
